I had a very unpleasant experience at this Kioko store in Oriente, which I always frequent and where I have a customer account, due to the attitude of an employee who was extremely arrogant and rude to me.

I even tried to put myself in his place and think that it was just an bad day, especially since he is also Brazilian, like me, but nothing justifies the way I was treated.

Today, I went to the store to buy shampoo and dewormer for my kitten. As I didn't know which product would be suitable, I asked where the dewormers were and asked for guidance. The employee responded arrogantly and unhelpfully. When I politely told him that he didn't need to speak to me that way, he started arguing, interpreted my words as a personal attack, and tried to justify his attitude with situations that didn't happen the way he described.

The situation became even more unpleasant when I expressed my intention to file a complaint and that I would speak to a supervisor or leave a comment on Google… HE OFFERED ME THE COMPLAINT BOOK WITH A MOCKING AIR, which I refused. Instead of trying to resolve the situation professionally, he continued with a disrespectful attitude and even mocked me several more times.

I don't expect employees to know everything, but I expect politeness, respect, and willingness to help, especially when they seek guidance on how to care for their animals.

I regret this experience, as the service left much to be desired. I hope that management becomes aware of what happened and gives due attention to how customers are treated in this store, especially by this employee, which is not the first time.

Last Wednesday I went there and he was also in a bad mood, but today was terrible.
I was pleased with Kiwoko; it's closer, larger, well-organized, and has excellent service.

BEST CAT STORE IN LISBON.
I'm a first-time cat mom, and the day before I went to pick up my cat, I went to the Kiwoko store in Oriente, which is across from the Oriente metro station.
I was completely lost, nervous, and anxious, not knowing what to buy or what my cat needed, but thanks to the employee Inês, my problem was completely solved, as if I had found an angel. I received IMMENSE support, patience, care, and willingness from the employee Inês, and I don't know what I would have done that day without her. We spent about an hour searching the store for everything I would need.
They have everything in that store at WONDERFUL prices. I left with 2 large bags full of various items suggested and recommended by the employee, and today I use them as indicated and I am completely satisfied.
Buy a lot from this store because I HIGHLY recommend it!! The store and the employee deserve it. 5 stars. I will always come back.

I was assisted a few months ago at the Gare do Oriente store by an extremely friendly employee, Sara, who above all had an impressive knowledge of pet food and veterinary products. She helped me choose the ideal food for my dog, explained everything in detail with great patience, and understood exactly what he had and what he needed.
The clear and informed way she explained everything made me understand the choice of food for my dog ​​much better, even more so than in some consultations where I had already raised these same doubts.
The experience was so positive that I returned to the store precisely because of that service. Unfortunately, she was no longer there this time, which was a shame, because professionals like that really make a difference and build trust with customers.
I would like to acknowledge the excellent work she did while she was at the store. Without a doubt, she is a professional that any team would be lucky to have.
